title: ORDER FOR SAFETY MEASURES
full_text:
■ Enforcement Rule of the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters Act [Attached Form 2] <Amended 2017.7.3>

ORDER FOR SAFETY MEASURES

| Section | Field | Entry |
|---|---|---|
| Person to receive the order | Name | ____________________ |
| | Date of birth | ____________________ |
| | Address | ____________________ (Telephone: ____________________) |
| Summary of safety inspection | Facility/area name | ____________________ |
| | Summary of inspection | ____________________ |
| | Results of safety inspection | ____________________ |
| Grounds for the order for safety measures | | ____________________ |
| Summary of safety measures | Measures to be taken | ____________________ |
| | Method of taking the safety measures | ____________________ |
| | Deadline for the safety measures | ____________________ |

Pursuant to Article 17(1) of the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters Act, Article 8 of the Enforcement Decree of that Act, and Article 6(1) of the Enforcement Rule of that Act, you are hereby ordered to take the safety measures stated above in respect of the facilities that you own, occupy, or manage. Please carry out the measures and complete and submit the attached notification of the results of safety measures.

Year _____ Month _____ Day _____

Special Self-Governing City Mayor
Head of Si/Gun/Gu
[Official seal]
